Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Is this legal?

Vampire A is blocked
Vampire A plays Form of Mist at Superior, and continues his action at
+1 stealth
Vampire B then plays Mask of 1000 faces, to continue that same action.

Can Vampire B then, if blocked, play Form of Mist at superior?

Messages.Author: Trey Morita
Messages.Body:
On Sat, 27 Jul 2002 21:21:31 GMT, Jozxyqk <jfeu...@eecs.tufts.edu> wrote:
> Is this legal?
>
> Vampire A is blocked
> Vampire A plays Form of Mist at Superior, and continues his action at
> +1 stealth
> Vampire B then plays Mask of 1000 faces, to continue that same action.

Assuming Vampire B has superior protean, this is legal.

> Can Vampire B then, if blocked, play Form of Mist at superior?

Yes, the restriction for action modifiers and reactions is one (by name)
per minion per action.

As always, I am not LSJ (IANLSJ).

Trey

I agree with Trey, that as long as Vampire B has PRO, it is legal. As he

minion*. Just like Mask + Lots of Venenations is legal, there's nothing to stop
Mask + Lots of Form of Mists from being played.

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>Form of mist is a combat card so the same vamp can play it over and over and
>over anyway.

At inferior, it is just a combat card and can be played multiple times.

At superior (and the vampire is not acting), it is just a combat card and can
be played multiple times.

At superior (and the vampire IS acting), it is a combat card *and* an action
modifier card and can be played only once each action.

Halcyan 2
